race.title: Racing TV Club Day Chase (Listed)
race.verdict: MONTY'S STAR gave a good account in a pair of Leopardstown Grade 1s last season before stretched by the trip in the Grand National, so he could be ready to get back to winning ways at this level. He is preferred ahead of Champ Kiely who ran up to his best on last season's return, with Ile Atlantique also considered. MONTY'S STAR (IRE) CHAMP KIELY (IRE) ILE ATLANTIQUE (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Monty's Star (9/4), Gerri Colombe (3/1), Champ Kiely (3/1), Ile Atlantique (9/2), Lecky Watson (8/1), High Class Hero (10/1), Apple's Of Bresil (50/1)
